records.noteEn: At least TWO years of professional and/or managerial experience is REQUIRED. Two referee reports and TWO study statements: 1,000 WORDS in Chinese plus 800 WORDS in English on the English page. Chinese page describes interview as possible while English says shortlisted applicants must interview; retain confirmation. Chinese fee text is malformed; the directly linked English page clearly quotes NON-LOCAL 224,400 / LOCAL 179,520. Optional shared MPPM English courses have their own English requirements; not a universal English gate. Compulsory non-credit-bearing course remains part of study.

Recognised bachelor/equivalent; shortlisted interview may apply. FT1/PT2 are both explicitly listed, including in the English fee-extension description. Research/internship capstone alternatives do not make this a research master.

SUBJECT TO UNIVERSITY APPROVAL. Recognised bachelor/equivalent; shortlisted interview and internal Putonghua assessment. GBA Internship/Practicum is an ELECTIVE among twelve, not compulsory mainland delivery for every student. No HSK numeric score is invented.

Recognised bachelor/equivalent; more than two years professional experience is PREFERRED, particularly mid/senior management. Two referees plus Chinese 1,000-WORD and English 800-WORD statements. Degree awarded OUTSIDE China including Hong Kong/Mainland/Taiwan/Macau grouping triggers published Chinese-exam alternatives; qualification location, not nationality. Interview wording differs between English/Chinese panels and needs confirmation. No prior law degree is stated as a universal hard requirement.

More than two years professional experience is PREFERRED, not a hard work-year gate. Shortlisted interview REQUIRED. TWO referees and an English 800-WORD statement. Page says primarily designed for prior-law applicants; the general entry clause is broader, so background/equivalence requires panel assessment. This LLM is NOT a shortcut or guaranteed eligibility for the national judicial examination.

Career-conversion, TWO-YEAR FT, 87 credits; prior education/counselling/psychology/nursing/early-childhood/social-work/health backgrounds are PREFERRED, not mandatory. FOUR clinical placements totalling at least 1,000 hours; site availability affects paediatric placement. Programme page reports WFOT approval, BUT Hong Kong OT Board accreditation is STILL PENDING. Graduation does not automatically confer registration, membership or an overseas licence.

At least two years professional/managerial experience is the normal route, BUT excellent fresh graduates MAY also be considered. No automatic hard failure for zero experience and no invented fresh-graduate GPA floor. Separate EMI and CMI codes each have FT1/PT2. Standard English applies ONLY to EMI A1M120/C2M049, not CMI A1M140/C2M063. Scholarships and post-entry research conditions are separate.
More than two years working experience is PREFERRED, not required. Shortlisted interview may apply; no mandatory ESG/finance undergraduate field inferred.

SUBJECT TO UNIVERSITY APPROVAL. More than two years professional experience is PREFERRED; essential Chinese proficiency, shortlisted interview, and TWO referee reports. No numeric Chinese test or hard work-year floor is invented.

SUBJECT TO UNIVERSITY APPROVAL. High proficiency in spoken and written Chinese; shortlisted interview may apply. No numeric Chinese test, gender restriction or mandatory undergraduate field is inferred from the programme title.

SUBJECT TO UNIVERSITY APPROVAL. At least two years professional experience is PREFERRED. English statement of purpose NO MORE THAN 1,000 WORDS is INVITED and considered, not described as mandatory for all applicants. Essential Chinese proficiency; shortlisted interview may apply.
SUBJECT TO UNIVERSITY APPROVAL. Recognised bachelor/equivalent; shortlisted interview may apply. Programme title does not create a beauty-profession licence or mandatory prior major.

Related economics/business/AI/data degree OR relevant work is PREFERRED; work explicitly NOT mandatory and excellent fresh graduates can be considered. ALL applicants should submit an ENGLISH statement of purpose NO MORE THAN 1,000 WORDS despite Chinese instruction. Essential Chinese proficiency; shortlisted interview may apply.
